objective: weekly profit = sum over days and depots of contribution per rental * rentals - sum over days and lanes of transfer cost * (undamaged + damaged transfers) - cost_per_car * fleet_size; contribution per rental at a depot = sum over return depots and rental lengths of return share * length share * (price for that return - marginal_cost + damaged_share * damage_excess)

repair_capacity.description: Damaged cars the depot can repair per day; a depot with positive capacity is a repair depot, a depot with 0 sends its damaged cars to a repair depot
repair_capacity.label: repair capacity

day.description: Trading day of the weekly cycle (the company is closed on Sunday)
day.label: day

order.description: Position in the weekly cycle (1 = Monday); the day after the last day is the first day again
order.label: position in the week

demand.description: Estimated number of cars customers want to rent at the depot on the day; upper bound on rentals (demand need not be met); a missing row means no demand
demand.label: rental demand

rental_days.description: Length of the rental; a car rented on a day comes back that many trading days later, in the morning
rental_days.label: rental length

share.description: Share of rentals that last this many days (the shares should sum to 1; they are not renormalised)
share.label: share of rentals

marginal_cost.description: Company's marginal cost of one rental of this length (wear and tear, administration)
marginal_cost.label: marginal cost per rental

price_same_depot.description: Price paid when the car is returned to the depot it was rented from
price_same_depot.label: price, return to same depot

price_other_depot.description: Price paid when the car is returned to another depot (one-way rental)
price_other_depot.label: price, return to another depot

from_depot.description: Depot the car is rented from
from_depot.label: rental depot

to_depot.description: Depot the car is returned to
to_depot.label: return depot

share.description: Share of the cars rented at from_depot that are returned to to_depot, independent of day and rental length (the shares out of each depot should sum to 1; they are not renormalised)
share.label: share returned

from_depot.description: Depot the car is sent from
from_depot.label: origin depot

to_depot.description: Depot the car is sent to
to_depot.label: destination depot

cost.description: Cost of moving one car (damaged or undamaged) between the two depots; a car sent on a day arrives the next morning; a transfer lane exists only where a row exists
cost.label: transfer cost per car

cost_per_car.description: Opportunity cost of owning one car for a week (interest on capital, storage, servicing)
cost_per_car.label: weekly cost of owning a car

damaged_share.description: Share of the cars returned by customers that come back damaged; the rest come back undamaged
damaged_share.label: damage rate of returned cars

damage_excess.description: Excess charged to the customer for each car returned damaged (the repair itself is insured); every rental earns damaged_share * damage_excess on average
damage_excess.label: damage excess charged

decision_variables.fleet_size: cars owned (>= 0): cars on rent plus cars at the depots at the start of the third trading day (Wednesday)
decision_variables.undamaged_stock[day, depot]: undamaged cars at the depot in the morning (returns, arrivals, repaired cars and cars kept overnight)
decision_variables.damaged_stock[day, depot]: damaged cars at the depot in the morning
decision_variables.undamaged_left[day, depot]: undamaged cars kept at the depot at the end of the day
decision_variables.damaged_left[day, depot]: damaged cars kept at the depot at the end of the day
decision_variables.undamaged_transfers[day, from_depot, to_: undamaged cars sent on the day, arriving the next morning
decision_variables.damaged_transfers[day, from_depot, to_de: damaged cars sent on the day, arriving the next morning
decision_variables.repairs[day, depot]: damaged cars repaired during the day, available for rent the next morning (0..repair_capacity)

constraints.undamaged_in[day, depot]: undamaged returns + undamaged transfers arriving + yesterday's repairs + undamaged cars kept yesterday = undamaged_stock (the day before the first day is the last day)
constraints.undamaged_out[day, depot]: rentals + undamaged transfers sent + undamaged cars kept = undamaged_stock
constraints.damaged_in[day, depot]: damaged returns + damaged cars kept yesterday (+ damaged transfers arriving, at a repair depot) = damaged_stock
constraints.damaged_out[day, depot]: repairs + damaged transfers sent + damaged cars kept = damaged_stock; a depot without a workshop sends to repair depots, a repair depot (as in the original) to depots without a workshop
constraints.fleet_count: fleet_size = cars rented earlier and still out at the start of the third trading day + undamaged and damaged stock at all depots that morning

undamaged_stock.label: undamaged cars at the depot in the morning

damaged_stock.label: damaged cars at the depot in the morning

undamaged_left.label: undamaged cars kept at the depot overnight

damaged_left.label: damaged cars kept at the depot overnight
